name: Grover Underwood
excerpt: Grover is Percy's best friend, who is scrawny and has a muscular disease.
notes:
Grover Underwood is Percy's best friend at Yancy Academy, characterized by his scrawny physique, acne, and a wispy beard. He suffers from a muscular disease that limits his physical abilities, allowing him to avoid physical education classes. Despite these challenges, Grover is a loyal friend who often tries to cover for Percy when he finds himself in trouble. He appears to be anxious about the strange occurrences surrounding Mrs. Dodds and seems to possess some knowledge of the supernatural elements at play, although he refrains from discussing them openly with Percy. His friendship with Percy is a source of support as they navigate the complexities of their school life together.

Grover Underwood is Percy's loyal best friend at Yancy Academy, characterized by his scrawny build and a muscular disease that limits his physical capabilities. Despite his own challenges, Grover is fiercely protective of Percy, often covering for him when trouble arises. He is deeply troubled by the strange occurrences surrounding them, particularly the ominous presence of a 'Kindly One' at school, which he fears could pose a threat to Percy. Grover's anxiety is palpable, especially when he overhears a conversation between Mr. Brunner and himself regarding Percy's safety and a looming deadline related to the summer solstice. He provides Percy with his contact information, indicating that he is prepared to help him if things take a turn for the worse. Grover's apprehension grows when they encounter the three old ladies at a fruit stand, particularly when one of them cuts a piece of yarn, an act that Grover interprets as a bad omen. Despite his nervous demeanor, Grover remains committed to supporting Percy, even if it means walking him home from the bus station, showcasing the depth of their friendship amidst the chaos they face.
